title: Reciprocal Cost on the Positive Rationals
summary: We study nonnegative solutions of the reciprocal cost law on the positive rationals and determine which of them admit regular extensions to the positive reals. Using the substitution $H=1+F$, we reduce the reciprocal composition law to d'Alembert's functional equation. We prove that every nonnegative solution on $\mathbb{Q}_{>0}$ is determined by one real weight $α_p$ for each prime $p$, with only a global sign identification.
